infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ScoutX needs access to Photos so you can upload highlight clips and match recordings from your library.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: ScoutX may save processed video thumbnails to your library when needed.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: ScoutX sends alerts when scouts view your Football Passport, you receive coach endorsements, trial invitations, and weekly career updates.

plugins.photosPermission: ScoutX needs access to Photos so you can upload highlight clips and match recordings from your library.
plugins.cameraPermission: ScoutX needs camera access so you can record highlight clips.
plugins.microphonePermission: ScoutX needs microphone access when recording video clips.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: ScoutX uses your location to record match movement, distance, and heatmaps.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: ScoutX uses your location to record match movement during sessions.
